notes: Community-maintained template. Values follow the device's stock build.prop and GPU driver strings; verify them against a current firmware dump before relying on them in a pull request. The hardware block is used only when "Emulate this phone's hardware" is on. The Snapdragon 8 Elite uses Qualcomm's custom Oryon cores, whose MIDR could not be sourced reliably, so this template omits the CPU block; the SoC and GPU identity still apply.
